name: The Adirondack Club Summer Camps
description_short: Summer day camps at The Adirondack Club, a fitness and family club in Franklin, MA: Adventure Camp (ages 5-14 in four age groups), Arts Camp and Sports Camp, which families can mix and match. Camp runs 8:45am to 3:45pm with pre-camp from 7:30am and post-camp to 6pm, and uses the club's pools, indoor space and outdoor play areas.
swim_waterfront_notes: The club has a 6-lane lap pool and a large shallow-entry recreation pool for younger campers; campers bring a bathing suit and towel daily.

sources.note: Camps overview: Adventure, Arts and Sports camps, mix and match; 'SUMMER CAMP 2027 INFORMATION COMING LATER THIS FALL!'
Contact page: 800 Chestnut Street, Franklin, MA 02038
Camp general information: drop-off 8:45, pick-up 3:45 (full day), pre-camp 7:30-8:45, post camp 4-6pm; Adventure groups ages 5-6 to 11-14
Adventure Camp FAQ: 6-lane lap pool, shallow-entry recreation pool, outdoor group play, air-conditioned indoor area

warnings: Only the 2026 season is shown, and it has already ended (today is 2026-10-13). There is nothing yet about summer 2027.
This is an overview page for three separate camps (Adventure, Arts, Sports). Dates, prices and ages are only in brochures that this text does not include.
The 'JULY CHILDCARE HOURS' block (Mon-Fri 7:45am-12:00pm, reservations at ext. 203) seems to be about the club's general childcare, not the summer camps, so it was not recorded as camp hours.
The page mentions a 'WEEK 10 NEWSLETTER', so the 2026 camp season probably ran for about 10 weeks. Not recorded as sessions.
